name: coda-webstore-cms
description: Store onboarding CMS for the coda-webstore-prototype repo. Self-contained (own deps, own vercel.json) so it can be deployed as its own Vercel project with Root Directory=tools/cms, per docs/Handoff's existing pattern for isolating a subproject's build/serverless functions from the storefront's. See server/writers/github.mjs for the hosted write layer this needs (CMS_WRITER=github) — the local fs writer only works when this runs via `npm run cms` at the repo root, where src/stores/ is actually on disk.
